title: Chess is Art: Punish the Queen Capture
summary: When the queen is offered, count the king’s flights before taking: a protected rook can deliver mate on an open file.

nodes.question: White has taken the queen. How can Black finish?
nodes.explanation: Rh3 checks Kg3 at close range. The g4 pawn protects the rook, while White’s own bishop, rook and f-pawn obstruct the king’s escape.

branches.title: Conditional source finish after Qxd3
commentary: Begin in the source variation after Qxd3. This verifies the punishment for accepting the queen, not every defense to the earlier g4 move.

Rh3# checks Kg3 horizontally from the adjacent file. Black’s g4 pawn protects h3 and controls f3; f5 protects g4. White’s own Rg2/Bf2/f4 block g2/f2/f4, and the rook controls h2/h4. There is no interposition square next to the king and no legal capture of the protected rook: actual mate.

exercises.prompt: Why can the king not take Rh3?
exercises.answer: Black’s g4 pawn attacks h3. Capturing the rook would move White’s king onto a protected square.

exercises.prompt: Does this show the actual game ended with Rh3 mate?
exercises.answer: No. This is the source’s conditional Qxd3 variation. The narrated game chose Rh2; that larger continuation is not certified by this exercise.

startContext: Conditional final rook-mate pattern only, after White accepts the queen with Qxd3 at134 seconds. Native41 establishes the full fourteen-piece diagram: White Kg3/Qd3/Rg2/Bf2/Nd4/a2/b3/f4 against Kh7/Rh6/a7/f5/g4/g7; native42 confirms Rh3 mate. The f4 pawn came from the earlier capture and remains on the board. Native43 shows an animated rook while the source resets a variation, not a stable rook on h4 to splice into the game. Rh3# has an exact finite certificate ending in actual mate. The earlier fifteen-piece g4 position and White refusal Rh2/Qxf3+/Nxf3 remain outside this proof. A bounded twelve-ply strategy search from that larger root did not complete a certificate; source resignation or material gain is not treated as proof of those larger outcomes.
